content:
toni: quick sync  proposal: lock a tiny public routing surface for all SDKs and move richer policy/context to an internal-only header that platform components attach. This should reduce churn in SDKs and keep console/quotas stable. thoughts?

rahul: agree in principle. what names are we locking?

toni: thinking: `x-rw-surface` (short k=v list), `x-rw-meta` (stable csv attribs), `x-rw-neg` (negotiation/version). internal-only: `x-rw-baggage-v2` (json blob, platform-only). SDKs must not send baggage by default.

mika: console requires tenant + billing tags to be present. `x-rw-meta` should include tenant and cost_center otherwise dashboard breakdowns will be wrong. We can add fallback rules but prefer explicit fields.

ops-bot: previous canary log: `header_parser_v3: unexpected end of input while parsing x-rw-baggage-v2` on edge-proxy-4.

rahul: looks like proxies truncate large headers. Options: (A) require base64 for baggage, (B) forbid client-public baggage and platform attaches it, or (C) chunk baggage into multiple numbered headers. Base64 is simplest for parsing but heavier for telemetry.

toni: I'm leaning to forbidding baggage from public SDKs. Platform can enrich requests on the internal mesh. SDKs keep to surface/meta/neg only. We'll add an opt-in env var for Dedicated/Private customers who explicitly want to send baggage.

mika: +1. I'll update console ingestion to prefer `x-rw-meta.cost_center` then fall back to parsing `x-rw-surface`. Add a dashboard migration so we don't lose historical data.

nora: SDK note: python/ts/go will implement a two-release compatibility shim: accept old wide header, prefer new `x-rw-surface`, and expose an env flag RW_ALLOW_BAGGAGE for private deployments. We'll include examples and tests.

toni: example headers we'll document: 
```
x-rw-surface: tenant=acme,env=prod
x-rw-neg: 1
x-rw-meta: cost_center=42,team=search
# x-rw-baggage-v2: {"policy":"cheap-first","trace":"abc"}  # platform-only/internal
```

ops-bot: note: edge-proxy has a 1024 byte header limit by default. Larger headers get truncated.

rahul: action items: @nora add compat code + tests in SDKs, @mika add ingestion fallback + dashboard note, @toni write RFC and deprecation timeline, @ops-bot file a ticket to bump proxy header limit in staging if needed.

nora: I'll draft release notes snippets:
- Python/TS/Go: minor bump. Parse `x-rw-surface` + `x-rw-meta`.
- Opt-in env RW_ALLOW_BAGGAGE for Dedicated customers only (disabled by default).
- Deprecation: public baggage forbidden after 12 weeks.

toni: timeline: RFC by EOD Wed, 2-week opt-in canary, deprecation notice at 12w. We'll monitor console telemetry after canary.

mika: thanks  I'll also add a small telemetry spike test to ensure mappings are stable during rollout.

ops-bot: canary scheduled Friday 07:00 UTC. Logs will be posted in #release-war-room.

nora: I'll open PRs and link here once ready.
